subject: website
name: FreeTube
summary: A YouTube client without ads or an account, built from upstream's open source at a pinned commit. It runs YouTube's player code and Google's BotGuard to play a video, which the user knows from Orivon's grant dialog and from why they open the app: Level 3. It is not Level 4: videos, search and comments come from YouTube or an Invidious instance relaying it, so the app relies on YouTube's servers. Subscriptions and history stay on this computer. Not private: YouTube sees what you watch.

operations.name: Watch, search and read comments
operations.note: The code does what it promises, but YouTube or the chosen Invidious instance decides what is served, and sees your IP address and what you watch.

operations.name: Keep subscriptions, history and playlists
operations.note: Stored only in this app's own files on this computer, with no account.

operations.name: Refresh the subscription feed
operations.note: Each subscribed channel is fetched from YouTube or Invidious, which can link the list to your IP address.

connections.name: YouTube (youtubei.googleapis.com, www.youtube.com, image hosts)
connections.note: Google's servers. Answers cannot be checked against anything else.

connections.name: Invidious instances
connections.note: Independent proxies of YouTube, used when chosen or as a fallback. Each sees your requests.

connections.name: SponsorBlock (sponsor.ajay.app)
connections.note: Crowd-sourced segment data, when turned on. Asked by a hash prefix of the video id.

connections.name: Return YouTube Dislike
connections.note: Estimated dislike counts from one service, when turned on.
